races.name: bet365 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LE BEAU MADRIK impressed as a novice hurdler and, with his reappearance under his belt, should prove too strong for the more exposed Florida Dreams on his chasing debut.

  1. LE BEAU MADRIK (FR)
  2. FLORIDA DREAMS (IRE)

races.name: Best Odds Guaranteed At bet365 Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
It's likely this will develop into a straight fight between bumper winners NATE OF SPADES and I've Got A Friend, with the latter narrowly preferred.

  1. NATE OF SPADES (IRE)
  2. I'VE GOT A FRIEND (IRE)
  3. WINGS OF THE GLEN (IRE)

races.name: bet365 Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
WASHINGTON is fancied to resume winning ways back in calmer waters. Handlethekettle will probably get the run of the race and rates the main danger.

  1. WASHINGTON
  2. HANDLETHEKETTLE (IRE)
  3. SERVICE MINIMUM (FR)

races.name: Paul Ferguson's Jumpers To Follow Wensleydale Juvenile Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MINELLA ROCKETT has developed into a useful Flat performer since his hurdling debut success over the summer and looks capable of making it 2-2 in this sphere. The chief threat among those with experience could be Vietnorm, who's proving similarly progressive, with Charles Darnay an interesting hurdling newcomer for an excellent yard.

  1. MINELLA ROCKETT (IRE)
  2. VIETNORM (IRE)
  3. CHARLES DARNAY

races.name: Bet Boost At bet365 Crossley Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KINGSTON NARCISSUS can gain compensation for his near miss in the Summer Plate and notch a second successive win in this event for Dan Skelton. Hat-trick-seeker Prairie Wolf may go one place better than he did in last year's renewal, with Genois best of the rest.

  1. KINGSTON NARCISSUS (FR)
  2. PRAIRIE WOLF (IRE)
  3. GENOIS (FR)

races.name: Racing Value At bet365 Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MIDNIGHT BELLA left her previous efforts over hurdles well behind when runner-up on her handicap debut at Newcastle in March and, with that form having proven strong, she's taken to go one better on her return to action, especially with her yard beginning to hit stride. Bright Legend, Noonetellsmenothin and Robber's Bridge complete the shortlist.

  1. MIDNIGHT BELLA
  2. BRIGHT LEGEND (IRE)
  3. NOONETELLSMENOTHIN (IRE)

races.name: Newmarket Challenge Whip Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This is a better race than the Southwell contest DOMINATION landed 3 weeks ago but he did that very nicely so a 6 lb rise may not prevent further success. Dove Tale and Dialstone both make their second handicap start for leading yards and they are feared most.

  1. DOMINATION (IRE)
  2. DOVE TALE (GER)
  3. DIALSTONE

races.name: German G1 Racecourses Thank World Pool British EBF Novice Stakes (C & G) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SOLO QUEST looked a sure-fire future winner when finding just smart prospect Born This Way too good at Yarmouth 3 weeks ago and has got to be the one to be with. Medvedev and Reign Over All head up a host of interesting newcomers.

  1. SOLO QUEST
  2. MEDVEDEV
  3. REIGN OVER ALL

races.name: German G1 Racecourses Thank World Pool British EBF Novice Stakes (C & G) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Out of a listed-winning mare, LAST HORIZON makes plenty of appeal on paper and he is the pick to make a successful debut with his yard continuing to go well. The son of Dubawi is taken to get the better of Dark Supremacy, who has shown promise in his 2 starts so far, with newcomer Jeremys Icon completing the shortlist.

  1. LAST HORIZON
  2. DARK SUPREMACY (IRE)
  3. JEREMYS ICON

races.name: 157 Grosser Preis Von Baden Handicap
races.verdict:
FENLANDER has proved better than ever with recent wins over C&D and at Leicester and he could be up to defying a double penalty in his current form. Marching Mac landed this race back in 2024 and is feared most as he also bids for a quick-fire hat-trick, ahead of Azuinthejungle who wasn't seen to best effect last time.

  1. FENLANDER
  2. MARCHING MAC (IRE)
  3. AZUINTHEJUNGLE

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF 'Bosra Sham' Fillies' Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
NICELY arrives after back-to-back in-frame efforts in Group 3/listed company and she gets the verdict over Siena Storm, who possesses the strongest form but wouldn't be certain to benefit from this drop to 6f. Love Is completes the shortlist.

  1. NICELY (IRE)
  2. SIENA STORM (GER)
  3. LOVE IS (IRE)

races.name: St Simon Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
AEGEAN PRINCE could barely have been more impressive despite having been off the track for almost a year when winning a Haydock handicap last time and is fancied to successfully step up in grade here at the chief expense of Al Aasy, who arrives on the back of Group successes at Deauville and Ascot. The likeable Evanesco can complete the 1-2-3.

  1. AEGEAN PRINCE
  2. AL AASY (IRE)
  3. EVANESCO

races.name: Munich's Grosser Dallmayr-Preis Handicap
races.verdict:
BERRY CLEVER looked better than ever when bagging his third victory of the year at Kempton earlier this month and still looks fairly treated. He makes fair appeal. Sail On Sailor and Ensor Mews head the list of dangers.

  1. BERRY CLEVER
  2. SAIL ON SAILOR
  3. ENSOR MEWS (IRE)

races.name: Westminster-137 Grosser Preis Von Berlin Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CARBINE COUNTRY will have learnt plenty from his encouraging debut here earlier this month and can get off the mark. Newcomers Guiding Force and I Know You By Now may provide the chief threat.

  1. CARBINE COUNTRY (IRE)
  2. GUIDING FORCE
  3. I KNOW YOU BY NOW (IRE)

races.name: German G1 Racecourses Thank World Pool Handicap
races.verdict:
AMUSED took advantage of a career-low mark when scoring here last week and is able to race off the same mark. He is taken to follow up. Handicap debutant Church Wedding looks a likely improver and is feared most, whilst Arundel can also make his presence felt.

  1. AMUSED (IRE)
  2. CHURCH WEDDING (IRE)
  3. ARUNDEL (IRE)

races.name: Kalahari King 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
None of the trio can be ruled out but Olly Murphy's HOLD THE SERVE is taken to build on the promise of his recent chasing debut second at Perth and go one better. Count of Vendome rates a big threat on his first go in this sphere, while fellow chasing newcomer Constellation Walk also needs considering.

  1. HOLD THE SERVE (IRE)
  2. COUNT OF VENDOME (IRE)
  3. CONSTELLATION WALK (IRE)

races.name: QuinnBet Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TARANIS DUBH took a step forward despite still looking green when going in at Worcester recently and with this step up in trip also a positive he is taken to concede weight all round. Nicky Henderson's Haydock bumper winner St Gabriel brings a fair bit of potential on his hurdling debut and rates a big threat though, while Iamtheidaho is another newcomer to this sphere to command respect.

  1. TARANIS DUBH
  2. ST GABRIEL (FR)
  3. IAMTHEIDAHO (IRE)

races.name: Support The Royal British Legion Poppy Appeal Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The market should reveal plenty here but the vote goes to French recruit MERRY WOOD who looked a good prospect when making a winning start for Olly Murphy in a Huntingdon bumper in the spring. Fellow hurdling newcomers Galaxy Star and Another Vega are also in very good hands and bring potential so command plenty of respect. Milly Ocean completes the shortlist.

  1. MERRY WOOD (FR)
  2. GALAXY STAR
  3. ANOTHER VEGA (IRE)

races.name: Abode Estate Agents Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but it could pay to side with Olly Murphy's handicap debutant EUSTACE GRENIER who has long given the impression this step up in trip will really suit and can get off the mark now. The returning Loustic Du Chatel heads a long list of dangers with the Henrietta Knight team going really well, although Circuit Breaker is also weighted to have a big say if back to his best. Kosasiempre, Springs A Girl and Las Canals also need factoring into this highly competitive handicap.

  1. EUSTACE GRENIER (FR)
  2. LOUSTIC DU CHATEL (FR)
  3. CIRCUIT BREAKER

races.name: Ted Anderson Dixon Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
The addition of Sean Bowen may well see KALLY DES BRUYERES double his tally over fences, while Kingston Gent, Kaviar Wood and Soldier In Mayo are the likely dangers of those with experience. The trio of chasing debutants all need a market check, with Nevershedatear perhaps most interesting on paper.

  1. KALLY DES BRUYERES (FR)
  2. KINGSTON GENT (IRE)
  3. KAVIAR WOOD (FR)

races.name: QuinnBet Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Fairly useful Flat winner CHICO MAGNIFICA is going the right way for Olly Murphy and can get off the mark over hurdles. Handicap debutants Ample Warning and Moves Like Mason are feared.

  1. CHICO MAGNIFICA (IRE)
  2. AMPLE WARNING (FR)
  3. MOVES LIKE MASON (IRE)

races.name: Bob Derry 50 Years At Uttoxeter NH Flat Race (Conditional/Amateurs) (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
LOU PRINCE changed hands for £240,000 after winning his sole outing in Irish points in March and, with a subsequent bumper back in third that day, the form looks strong. He can maintain his unbeaten record switched to Rules, perhaps at the expense of Givemeyourword, who found only a promising sort too good on her sole start between the flags. Hello Charlie also needs a close look having joined the Skeltons.

  1. LOU PRINCE (FR)
  2. GIVEMEYOURWORD (IRE)
  3. HELLO CHARLIE (IRE)

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
ALEMBIC showed improved form on his return at Southwell 11 days ago, shaping as if he'd come on for the outing, and this step up in trip should suit on breeding so he's well fancied against exposed rivals here. Golspie is very consistent and a C&D winner so could be a threat, while Urban Road is down to a good mark if coming on for his recent return.

  1. ALEMBIC
  2. GOLSPIE (IRE)
  3. URBAN ROAD

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
KEOGIE has some solid-looking Irish form to his name and could be the one to back starting out for a new yard given several of the other interesting runners all have something to prove. Venetian Sky has had a few chances but should be in the mix once more, while the interesting Petula will need a look in the betting returning from a long time off.

  1. KEOGIE (IRE)
  2. VENETIAN SKY (FR)
  3. PETULA

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
races.verdict:
PEQUENITA has filled the runner-up spot 3 times in succession, including her best effort on all-weather at Kempton in September, and this could prove the ideal opportunity for her to break her duck. Lady Caroline Lamb shaped better than her Kempton fifth suggests 16 days ago after a 12-week break and should be sharper now so looks the biggest danger, though Xochipilli is bred to appreciate the step up to 1m and needs considering.

  1. PEQUENITA
  2. LADY CAROLINE LAMB
  3. XOCHIPILLI

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict:
ENNOBLE went very close in a novice here recently and is much less exposed than most of these so could make a winning start to life in handicaps. Both Storm Esme and Brave Traveller have C&D wins to their names and look good each-way options.

  1. ENNOBLE (IRE)
  2. STORM ESME
  3. BRAVE TRAVELLER

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
ELYAM has made massive progress for his new yard after a long absence and is likely to prove hard to stop in his hat-trick attempt. Tatterstall responded well to headgear when scoring at Lingfield so is next best ahead of Against The Wind, who hinted at a revival in the Portland.

  1. ELYAM
  2. TATTERSTALL (IRE)
  3. AGAINST THE WIND

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
races.verdict:
Low-mileage 4-y-o POPPEYE beat a subsequent winner in decisive fashion over C&D 10 days ago so holds obvious claims under a penalty. Sea Legend shaped well behind the selection that day after 6 months off so may emerge as the main threat on 5 lb better terms, with the thriving Coramento also respected.

  1. POPPEYE
  2. SEA LEGEND (FR)
  3. CORAMENTO

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
races.verdict:
A few of these are lurking on dangerous marks, notably TIRIAC, who has caught the eye on turf of late and has a good record here. Massimo Blue is the obvious threat under a penalty given the progress he has made for his current yard.

  1. TIRIAC
  2. MASSIMO BLUE
  3. BRIGHT (IRE)

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
CONCERT BOY might be worth chancing having dipped to a tempting mark on all-weather. Lanarra, course specialist Tomorrow Day and last week's C&D scorer Yaajooz head the dangers.

  1. CONCERT BOY (IRE)
  2. LANARRA (IRE)
  3. TOMORROW DAY

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
If CAVALLO PAZZO is in the same form as when scoring over C&D a couple of weeks ago he might be able to defy the handicapper. Pit Boss, Ey Up He's A Star and Victory Sound are others likely to be on the premises.

  1. CAVALLO PAZZO (IRE)
  2. PIT BOSS
  3. EY UP HE'S A STAR

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
If SOUTHERN BOULEVARD can reproduce the form she showed when fourth in a C&D listed event at the beginning of the month she could take a bit of stopping. Monologue likely has more to offer and should be bang there, while Aidan O'Brien newcomer Pure Power will be a threat to all if the betting speaks in his favour.

  1. SOUTHERN BOULEVARD (IRE)
  2. MONOLOGUE (IRE)
  3. PURE POWER (IRE)

races.name: View Restaurant At Dundalk Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
Preference is for C&D winner JORDAN BREEZE, who has dropped to a handy mark and signalled a return to form at the Curragh earlier this month. The Adrian McGuinness duo Blue Anthem and One Cool Bear head the list of dangers.

  1. JORDAN BREEZE (IRE)
  2. BLUE ANTHEM
  3. ONE COOL BEAR (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Bet 10 Get 50' Handicap
races.verdict:
BIG GOSSEY ran well on his last visit here and has recorded a couple of victories in better company since. He gets the nod. Mehman and Bear On The Run rate the principal dangers.

  1. BIG GOSSEY (IRE)
  2. MEHMAN
  3. BEAR ON THE RUN (IRE)

races.name: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Maiden
races.verdict:
This can go to WEARING STARS, who acquitted herself well in listed company at Killarney last time and is back in calmer waters here. Lookingforarainbow and Riyazanka can give her most to think about.

  1. WEARING STARS (IRE)
  2. LOOKINGFORARAINBOW (USA)
  3. RIYAZANKA (IRE)

races.name: Happy Halloween Handicap
races.verdict:
Preference is for DALER who has continued in good heart since his Leopardstown success in June, not seen to entirely best effect when third over C&D last time. He could be ready to get back to winning ways, though Suir Monad isn't taken lightly having shown improved form on his last 2 starts. Send Harry completes the shortlist.

  1. DALER (IRE)
  2. SUIR MONAD (IRE)
  3. SEND HARRY (IRE)

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
GO OUT looks a significantly more attractive proposition on all-weather and he can go one place better than he did here a fortnight ago. The consistent Storm Eric should be in the mix again, with Medieval Night and Polanco also meriting consideration.

  1. GO OUT (FR)
  2. STORM ERIC (IRE)
  3. MEDIEVAL NIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Book Your Christmas Party At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict:
SERENITY BLUE still looks feasibly treated after his decisive winning debut for Adrian McGuinness earlier this month and may be able to score again in the finale. Nermal and Zoffman are also of interest.

  1. SERENITY BLUE
  2. NERMAL (IRE)
  3. ZOFFMAN (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
Grade 1 bumper winner WITH NOLIMIT should prove a cut above his rivals on hurdling debut. Stablemate Water Mill can fight it out with Master Locksley and Confidence Within for the places.

  1. WITH NOLIMIT (FR)
  2. WATER MILL (IRE)
  3. MASTER LOCKSLEY (IRE)

races.name: Eventsec Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
DARK LIEUTENANT has been shaping up well in handicaps and the step up to 3m could be the catalyst for a breakthrough success. Juke Box Rock has to be feared if returning in the same form that saw him win on chasing debut this time last year, with Annie Button and Sneddy Eddie best of the rest in an ultra-competitive event.

  1. DARK LIEUTENANT (IRE)
  2. JUKE BOX ROCK (IRE)
  3. ANNIE BUTTON (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Feathard Lady Mares Novice Hurdle (Grade 3)
races.verdict:
SWITCH FROM DIESEL was below her previous best on her most recent outing at Gowran but time may show she well and truly bumped into one, so she's well worth another chance. Beir Bua has a likeable way of going about things and heads up the opposition, along with Alliteration, who has progressed with each run over hurdles.

  1. SWITCH FROM DIESEL (IRE)
  2. BEIR BUA (IRE)
  3. ALLITERATION (IRE)

races.name: bottlegreen Hurdle (Listed)
races.verdict:
BLAKE posted an excellent second at Punchestown when last seen in this sphere in the spring and on the back of a promising reappearance eighth on the Flat in the Irish Cesarewitch he gets the nod. Gordon Elliott has captured the last 5 runnings of this though and his Mange Tout (the choice of Jack Kennedy) and El Cairos rate big threats.

  1. BLAKE
  2. MANGE TOUT (FR)
  3. EL CAIROS (FR)

races.name: Metcollect Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
RIGHTFOLKSPLEASE can complete the hat-trick if returning at the top of his game. Claude, Court Canyon and Manoir De Mirande all hold credible claims in an open-looking handicap.

  1. RIGHTFOLKSPLEASE (IRE)
  2. CLAUDE (IRE)
  3. MANOIR DE MIRANDE (FR)

races.name: BetVictor Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
Gordon Elliott has a remarkable record in this race, winning 9 of the last 10 renewals, and he has an excellent chance of adding to that tally with BALLYFAD, who is comfortably the best of these over hurdles and was an impressive winner on his sole start in a point. It's probably significant that French-recruit Matin Midi et Soir was sent off favourite when down the field in the Grade 1 Champion Juvenile Hurdle at the Punchestown Festival, and he rates as the primary threat.

  1. BALLYFAD (IRE)
  2. MATIN MIDI ET SOIR (FR)
  3. PORT AUTHORITY (IRE)

races.name: WTW Willis Flat Race
races.verdict:
PREMIER DIVISION has shaped with plenty of promise on all 3 bumper outings to date, posting his best effort yet when second at Punchestown in the spring, a big move to get to the front-running winner seemingly telling late on. He sets a high standard stepping back in trip and firmly rates the one to beat. Passenger in first-time cheekpieces, Nine Toes Tim and Rokanako are others fancied to feature.

  1. PREMIER DIVISION (IRE)
  2. PASSENGER (IRE)
  3. NINE TOES TIM (IRE)
